design: Retrospective descriptive case selection using existing sealed five-fold Ictal Outer scores only; no training, model inference, threshold selection or performance claim from case selection.

drechan.variant: Original complete three-seed FULL, with early FiLM/late Gate; not later no-guidance FULL and not LOCO

classification: Use the historical VAL-selected threshold and native orientation unchanged; DRE score_nez < threshold; SVM frozen prediction_ez.
ranking: EZ direction; unrounded scores; decreasing score with original canonical channel-name ascending tie key. Recall uses ceil(q*N).
seed_aggregation: Mean each patient's endpoints across the three seeds, never ensemble scores or probabilities. Retain all per-seed results.
positive_eligibility: Basic eligibility plus strictly positive SVM AUROC/Recall@10% changes and positive DRE three-seed mean AUROC/Recall@10% changes; at least two DRE seeds jointly positive for both endpoints. Strict means >1e-12.
representativeness: For each eligible pool, compute midrank empirical percentiles of four changes: SVM AUROC, SVM Recall@10%, DRE mean AUROC, DRE mean Recall@10%. Choose minimum mean absolute percentile distance to 50%. Tie-break by more jointly consistent DRE seeds, then SHA256(case_selection_v1|private patient identifier).
negative_eligibility_priority: Basic plus strictly negative AUROC and Recall@10% changes in both SVM and DRE mean, with at least two jointly negative DRE seeds
Basic plus strictly negative DRE mean AUROC and Recall@10%, with at least two jointly negative DRE seeds; SVM direction unrestricted
Basic plus strictly negative DRE mean AUROC, nonpositive Recall@10%, at least two DRE seeds with negative AUROC; SVM direction unrestricted
percentile: 100*(number strictly lower + 0.5*number tied)/population size, tolerance1e-12. Report all80 and the relevant selection-pool percentiles. Pool medians and all screening counts are disclosed.
privacy: True patient IDs and original contact names remain on the trusted server. Public selected-case tables use CASE-P01/CASE-N01 and CH0001 aliases preserving canonical tie order. Export per-channel true class, frozen scores, decisions/ranks and every-K recall data only for the two deidentified selected cases. The original 80-patient table and reversible mapping remain private.
verification: Verify parent freeze/seal/source/checkpoint/validation hashes and complete role coverage; independent patient endpoints, source aggregate replay, independent selection, all selected-channel ranks and Recall@K reconstruction. Rehash protected parents after analysis.
